name: Hotel Fleck
beschreibung: Hotel Fleck is set in a peaceful village within the Kufstein region of the Tyrolean Alps. The surrounding mountains boast scenic hiking paths in summer and quick access to popular ski areas in winter. The hotel reflects traditional alpine architecture and a relaxed atmosphere. Facilities include a wellness suite with sauna and steam bath, alongside a restaurant serving hearty Tyrolean cuisine, making it a great destination for both active sports and restful holidays.
kurzbeschreibung: Hotel Fleck in the Kufstein area provides a tranquil alpine retreat, offering a sauna wellness area, authentic Tyrolean dining, and easy access to hiking and ski slopes.
